topic_zh: 延迟数字：内存、SSD、网络、跨洲，差几个数量级
topic_en: Latency numbers: memory, SSD, network, cross-continent

xhs.title: 读内存和跨洲请求，差了多少倍？
xhs.body:
系统设计第 5 课：延迟数字（都是数量级，看硬件会变）
读一次内存：约 100 纳秒
SSD 随机读：约 100 微秒，慢约一千倍
同机房往返：约 0.5 毫秒；跨洲往返：约 100 毫秒级
跨洲比读内存慢约一百万倍，光速摆在那儿，加机器也没用
考考你：顺序调 10 次跨洲服务，每次约 100 毫秒，光网络要等多久？A 约 0.1 秒 B 约 1 秒，评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: A memory read vs. a cross-continent request: about a million times apart. The latency numbers every engineer should know, in one minute. Quick quiz: 10 cross-continent calls in a row, ~100 ms each. Network wait: A ~0.1 s or B ~1 s? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: A memory read and a cross-continent request are about a million times apart.
linkedin.body:
Rough orders of magnitude (hardware-dependent):
Memory read ~100 ns. SSD random read ~100 µs. Round trip in one datacenter ~0.5 ms. Cross-continent round trip: on the order of 100 ms.
The last one is physics: light in fiber covers ~200,000 km/s, so more servers won't shrink it.
That's why hot data lives in memory and services sit close to users. The cost: memory is pricey and multi-region is complex.
Quick quiz: 10 cross-continent calls in a row, ~100 ms each. How long is the network wait? A ~0.1 s or B ~1 s?

quiz.q_zh: 顺序调 10 次跨洲服务，每次往返约 100 毫秒，光网络要等多久？A 约 0.1 秒 B 约 1 秒
quiz.q_en: 10 cross-continent calls in a row, ~100 ms round trip each. How long is the network wait? A ~0.1 s or B ~1 s?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：B，约 1 秒。顺序调用要一次次等，10 × 100 毫秒 = 1000 毫秒。能并发就并发，或者把服务放近点。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: B, about 1 second. Sequential calls wait one after another: 10 × 100 ms = 1,000 ms. Run them in parallel or move the service closer.
